# fortiappseccloud_waf_template_cookie_security

Configures cookie security for one FortiAppSec Cloud WAF template using the static template endpoint `/waf/template/{template_id}/cookie_security`. This resource owns the template's module settings. To make an application inherit them, configure the matching app module resource with `template = true` and omit its `configs` block.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_cookie_security` resource for a WAF template.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_template_cookie_security" "example" {
  template_id = fortiappseccloud_waf_template.example.template_id

  configs {
    status            = true
    action            = "alert_deny"
    mode              = "signed"
    replay_protection = true
    max_age           = 180
    secure_cookie     = true
    http_only         = true
    samesite          = false
    samesite_value    = "Lax"

    cookie_except_list {
      item {
        name     = "__utma"
        wildcard = false
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `template_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — WAF template ID.
- `configs` (Required) — Typed cookie security configuration. Its attributes and ownership-wrapper blocks are identical to `fortiappseccloud_waf_cookie_security` when that app resource uses `template = false`.

## Import

Import using the template ID:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_template_cookie_security.example TEMPLATE_ID
```

The first read after import hydrates all supported ownership wrappers.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
